title: Indako
text: 1. Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Indakūṭe pabbate Indakassa yakkhassa bhavane || || 2. Atha kho Indako yakkho yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi || || Rūpaṃ na jīvan ti vadanti buddhā || kathaṃ nvayaṃ vindat-imaṃ sarīraṃ || kut-assa aṭṭhīyakapiṇḍam eti || kathaṃ nvayaṃ sajjati gabbharasmin ti || || 3. Pathamaṃ kalalaṃ hoti || kalalā hoti abbudaṃ || abbudā jāyate pesī || pesī nibbattati ghano || ghanā pasākhā jāyanti || kesā lomā nakhāni ca || || yañ c-assa bhuñjati māta || annam pānañ ca bhojanaṃ || tena so tattha yāpeti || mātukucchigato naro ti || ||
